answer: Every identity stores one crystal shard cut from the shared orchard, and a lottery picks one of 6 color classes for recall per epoch. When violet is drawn, each violet identity must return its shard verbatim in 90 seconds. Five auditors check each shard against the orchard registry that epoch; a wrong or late shard voids the identity and burns its $50 bond. Identities sharing one device pay $5 times the square of identities on it, so 100 clones on one machine owe $55,000 in fees and bonds while 100 honest agents pay $5,500. A clone farm is a juggler handed a hundred crystal balls at once.
